args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT and MinIO bucket creation notes to local setup steps
args.body:
File: README.md

Add a line in the 'Running locally' section to instruct users to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO. Also add a note to create the MinIO bucket via its console before uploading, as mentioned in the issue discussion.
